name: Quizado
title: quizado.com
shortDescription: Quizado offers a platform for hosting interactive game shows like Jeopardy and Family Feud, tailored for team building. It's designed for managers and employees to enhance engagement and teamwork. Users can customize games with their branding, choose from various questions, or create their own. Ideal for both online and in-person events, it provides a unique way to connect and have fun in corporate settings.
cons: May not suit all corporate cultures
